verdict.rationale: The Department's own pages include some plain-language procedural guidance rather than bare statute text: a recommendation to register via the online Florida Business Tax Application (fl-dor-docs-8), a description of the electronic certification step before filing Form RT-6 (fl-dor-docs-5), instructions for reversing E-Verify certification (fl-dor-docs-7), and a publication explaining how to log in and recover credentials (fl-dor-docs-18). Most of the pack, though, is technical specs, form references and login-page fragments, and the registration flow itself sits behind an authenticated shell (fl-dor-probe-3). missing for 10: evidence of end-to-end step-by-step explainers for founder tasks such as registering a business or filing a first return, guidance aimed at non-lawyers beyond reemployment-tax snippets, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the guidance is followable.
